subject: Computação
description_pt: Analisar problemas sociais de sua cidade e estado a partir de ambientes digitais, propondo soluções. Entender que as tecnologias devem ser utilizadas de maneira segura, ética e responsável, respeitando direitos autorais, de imagem e as leis vigentes.

components.description_pt: Identificar problemas sociais em sua cidade ou estado usando ambientes digitais e dados
components.description_en: Identify social problems in one's city or state using digital environments and data

components.description_pt: Propor soluções baseadas em tecnologia para problemas sociais identificados através de análise digital
components.description_en: Propose technology-based solutions to social problems identified through digital analysis
components.cc_component_description: Generate multiple distinct design solutions to a given engineering problem

components.description_pt: Reconhecer responsabilidades éticas e legais ao usar tecnologias digitais para abordar questões sociais
components.description_en: Recognize ethical and legal responsibilities when using digital technologies to address social issues
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a proposed investigation or design solution for adherence to safety and ethical standards

cc_matches.description: Plan and conduct an investigation or test a design solution in a safe and ethical manner including considerations of environmental, social, and personal impacts.
Generate and compare multiple possible solutions to a problem based on how well each is likely to meet the criteria and constraints of the problem.
